responsibility_name: Ensure waking at seven each morning

evidence.evidence_text: If it is 7:00, the alarm goes off.

coding.rationale: Alarm at 7:00 supports waking on time each morning.

responsibility_name: help user wake up on weekday mornings

evidence.evidence_text: IF it is Monday and Tuesday AND the user does not get up from the bed before 7:30 RAISE the shutters AND TURN ON the coffee machine

coding.rationale: Weekday failure to get up before 7:30 triggers actions intended to wake the user.

responsibility_name: prepare dining environment before scheduled dinner

evidence.evidence_text: IF dinner with friends is set at 20:00, WHEN it is 19:30 TURN ON the oven AND set dim lights mode in the dining room.

coding.rationale: Oven and dining-room lighting are prepared before the scheduled dinner.

responsibility_name: provide optional music during shower

evidence.evidence_text: Assuming you have an automated bathroom at home, have a sensor that recognizes when the hot water in the shower opens and when you go into the shower and activates the stereo by playing the music from your favorite playlists and which also recognizes a stop command in case you don't want to listen to music.

coding.rationale: Music is optionally provided during the resident's shower and can be stopped on request.

responsibility_name: Support a consistent wake-up morning routine

evidence.evidence_text: When the sensor detects that the person gets out of bed, if the time is between 7:30 and 8:30, if the user's smart watch detects the heartbeat between 60 and 80, then the electric coffee machine comes on and the kitchen roller shutter goes up.

coding.rationale: When morning conditions are met, coffee and the kitchen shutter support a consistent wake-up routine.

responsibility_name: support distraction-free studying

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user studies AND the TV is on OR the smartphone's social networks are not in stand-by TURN OFF the TV AND enable stand-by mode for social apps.

coding.rationale: During studying, disabling TV and social-app interruptions preserves a distraction-free setting.

responsibility_name: Support the morning bath routine

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the bathroom and the time is between 7:00 and 8:00, the light goes on and the tap in the bathtub opens.

coding.rationale: Bathroom entry during the morning window prepares light and bath water for the routine.

responsibility_name: support undistracted comfortable reading environment

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is in the room, if he says "reading mode" to Alexa or if he sets the reading mode from the smartwatch, then adjust the brightness of the lamp to 2 and set the smartphone to do not disturb

coding.rationale: Reading mode adjusts light and phone interruptions for comfortable, undistracted reading.

responsibility_name: wake up reliably in the morning

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user NOT switches off the alarm as soon as it starts sounding TURN ON the lights gradually AND RAISE the rolling shutters in successive steps.

coding.rationale: If the alarm is not dismissed, gradual lights and shutters help ensure the resident wakes.

responsibility_name: alert occupants to failed door access attempts

evidence.evidence_text: When the fingerprint reader does not recognize the fingerprint, it sends a notification to the mobile phone and rings the bell.

coding.rationale: Unrecognized fingerprints are reported to occupants as failed access attempts.

responsibility_name: avoid heating while windows are open

evidence.evidence_text: If I open the window and the heating is on, turn off the heating system and notify me with a notification

coding.rationale: Opening a window while heating is on turns heating off and alerts the user to avoid wasted heat.

responsibility_name: ensure emergency lighting

evidence.evidence_text: If the fire alarm goes off, or when there is no electricity in the house, turn on the auxiliary lights and initiate an emergency call.

coding.rationale: Fire or power-loss events trigger auxiliary lighting for emergency visibility.

responsibility_name: initiate an emergency call

evidence.evidence_text: If the fire alarm goes off, or when there is no electricity in the house, turn on the auxiliary lights and initiate an emergency call.

coding.rationale: Fire or power-loss events trigger an emergency call for assistance.

responsibility_name: Ensure expected deliveries trigger gate access and notification

evidence.evidence_text: When the courier is near, if the user has placed an order online, open the gate and send a message on the mobile

coding.rationale: An expected courier's arrival is handled by opening the gate and notifying the user.

responsibility_name: Ensure only authorised vehicles can open the garage gate

evidence.evidence_text: When a car approaches the entrance gate of the garage of the house, it is identified by a proximity sensor which will automatically trigger an initial recognition check of the car based on the infrared emitted by a specific key. If the first check is unsuccessful, an intelligent camera will scan the license plate trying to match the authorized cars. Once the checks have been carried out, the garage gate will then be opened and the lights inside will be turned on.

coding.rationale: Vehicle identity checks ensure that only authorized vehicles receive garage access.

responsibility_name: ensure the garage is closed after parking

evidence.evidence_text: When the car enters the garage and if the parked car does not move for 10 seconds, the garage door will close automatically and the lights will turn on.

coding.rationale: After parking remains still for 10 seconds, closing the garage preserves garage security.

responsibility_name: ensure the garage is lit after parking

evidence.evidence_text: When the car enters the garage and if the parked car does not move for 10 seconds, the garage door will close automatically and the lights will turn on.

coding.rationale: After parking remains still for 10 seconds, lighting the garage preserves visibility.

responsibility_name: Ensure the water system is shut off and the owner alerted on leakage

evidence.evidence_text: If I turn off the kitchen tap, all the taps in the house are closed and the water meter continues to measure, the house water system is turned off and the user receives a notification on the phone of a possible lost.

coding.rationale: Suspected leakage causes the home water system to shut off and alerts the owner.

responsibility_name: Ensure waking when the alarm clock is not switched off

evidence.evidence_text: When the user does not switch off the alarm clock, the rolling shutters go up and the light switches on.

coding.rationale: An alarm that is not switched off triggers shutters and light to help the user wake.

responsibility_name: Keep the house warm when the fireplace dies down

evidence.evidence_text: When the fireplace is about to go out with the house not yet warm and it's cold outside, I get a notification on my phone and the heating turns on.

coding.rationale: When the fireplace dies down in a cold, not-yet-warm house, heating restores warmth and alerts the user.

responsibility_name: maintain home security

evidence.evidence_text: When no one is home, cameras turn on and remote alarm notifications are triggered
When the user is not at home activate the alarm system and close all the shutters.
IF the user is NOT at home DO activate burglar alarm systems AND lock the door lock AND turn off the water and gas.
When it is 11pm on a weekday or 2am on a holiday, if the user is not at home, turn off the lights, lock the windows and the door.
If the user is not at home, enable the alarm and send an SMS notification to the user to notify him of the activation.

coding.rationale: When unoccupied, alarms, locks, shutters, utilities, and notifications maintain home security.

responsibility_name: manage visitor gate access remotely

evidence.evidence_text: When the motion sensors detect the user in the bathroom, if the intercom detects a stranger and the user is using the phone, then he can answer the intercom with the phone and open the gate with the phone

coding.rationale: The resident can answer an intercom and open the gate remotely for a visitor.

responsibility_name: Prevent bath overflow when left unattended

evidence.evidence_text: When user turns on bathtub faucet, if tub fills and user is not in bathroom, automatically turn off faucet and notify user via Alexa message that tub is ready .

coding.rationale: When an unattended bath fills, stopping the faucet prevents overflow and informs the user.

responsibility_name: Prevent fire hazards from unattended heated appliances

evidence.evidence_text: IF the user is NOT at home and forgets the hair straightener is turned ON TURN OFF the power and SEND an alert notification to the user.

coding.rationale: Turning off an unattended hair straightener while away prevents a fire hazard and alerts the user.

responsibility_name: prevent gas and carbon monoxide hazard from stove

evidence.evidence_text: when the sensor detects the ignition of a stove and detects the presence of carbon black and detects the amount of gas in the air greater than 0.08%, turn off the stove, turn on the venola and open the windows.

coding.rationale: Excess gas and carbon-black conditions at stove ignition prompt shutoff and ventilation to prevent harm.

responsibility_name: prevent harm from gas leaks when unoccupied

evidence.evidence_text: When the infrared sensor does not detect any human and/or animal heat and if a gas leak is detected, a notification is sent to the user and the gas is automatically closed.

coding.rationale: An unoccupied home with detected gas leakage is protected by gas shutoff and user notification.

responsibility_name: prevent kitchen fires when unattended

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is not in the kitchen, the fire sensors are activated and the plates are turned off

coding.rationale: When the kitchen is unattended, fire sensing is enabled and plates are turned off.

responsibility_name: protect home electronics during storms

evidence.evidence_text: If there is a storm outside and the TV is on, turn off the TV and all the lights in the house

coding.rationale: During a storm, turning off the TV and lights protects household electronics.

responsibility_name: protect household against intrusion

evidence.evidence_text: If the camera and sensors notice suspicious movements around the house after 10.00 pm and if an unknown user tries to enter through a door or window, ACTIVATE the anti-theft alarm and SEND notification to home users

coding.rationale: Nighttime suspicious movement and attempted entry trigger an anti-theft response and notifications.

responsibility_name: protect pool during storms

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN there is a storm COVER the pool

coding.rationale: Covering the pool during a storm protects it from storm conditions.

responsibility_name: respond to failed alarm code entry attempts

evidence.evidence_text: When the alarm code is not entered correctly, connect the video door phone camera to the app and send notification to user

coding.rationale: Incorrect alarm-code entry triggers camera connection and notification to the user.

responsibility_name: Ensure the pellet tank is refilled before it runs out

evidence.evidence_text: When the sensor that detects the weight of the pellets inside the tank is less than 2 Kg, an automatic notification is sent to the set telephone number containing the message "Tank to Refill"

coding.rationale: A pellet weight below 2 kg prompts refill notification before the tank runs out.

responsibility_name: have coffee ready at wake time

evidence.evidence_text: When the alarm goes off, the coffee machine turns on

coding.rationale: Turning on the coffee machine when the alarm sounds prepares coffee for wake time.

responsibility_name: Have morning coffee ready at eight

evidence.evidence_text: If it's 8:00, turn on the electric coffee maker in the kitchen.

coding.rationale: Turning on the kitchen coffee maker at 8:00 prepares morning coffee.
